newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Sec seeking bank in France.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Sec seeking bank in France.

text.p: Daewoo Securities Co, a unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Tuesday it was seeking to buy a bank in France or elsewhere in Europe.
"We think it is necessary to set up a bank in Europe to support our investment in the region, especially in eastern Europe," said company spokesman Chun Ki-hwa.

Chun, however, denied a local media report that Daewoo was offered by the French government to buy a state-run commercial bank for one franc on condition that Daewoo invest $50 million after the purchase.
He declined to give further details.
Daewoo Group already has some European exposure.
The group's automobile subsidiary has committed to investing billions of dollars in Romania's vehicle industry, while Daewoo Securities finalised the purchase of a bank in Hungary last year.
